name: Bristleback Retreat
summary: A Magram commander sends you to Bristleback Retreat to confront quilboar carrying an artifact from a nearby temple. Their foothold has hindered the Magram camp’s work.

sections.title: The Magram Foothold
sections.body: Across Valley of Bones in Desolace, the Magram have made a small camp before marching into a nearby forest. A Bristleback intrusion blocks their way. The quilboar arrived around the same time as the Magram and took an artifact from a nearby temple. You are sent to Bristleback Retreat to slay quilboar, then report to Hagiak at the Magram Front.

sections.title: A Change of Purpose
sections.body: At the Magram Front, Hagiak says your presence has delayed the camp’s work and that you are not needed there. He then reconsiders and has another use for you as a soldier.

faq.q: Why does the Magram want quilboar slain?
faq.answer: The Bristlebacks have taken an artifact from a nearby temple, and their intrusion is hindering the Magram camp.
Bristleback Retreat is across Valley of Bones in Desolace.
Report to Hagiak at the Magram Front, across Valley of Bones in Desolace.

faq.q: What is the Magram preparing to do?
faq.answer: The Magram have established a small foothold to prepare for a march into a nearby forest.
